title: Claude Code plugin default settings
description: A plugin's root settings.json, or the manifest's settings object, as Claude Code 2.1.330 reads it (Agent Plugins Extended 1.1.0, section 12.6). The feature is deprecated: only agent takes effect, with a deprecation warning; subagentStatusLine was removed and has no effect, though a validator still warns that it is deprecated in favor of mods; every other key is dropped at load without an error, so it is accepted here.
$comment: Every key but agent is dropped at load, and so is an agent that is not a string, or a file that is not an object; none of it stops the plugin (section 12.6 item 1, Judgment J12.10). So the root accepts any JSON value, and $defs/effective states the values that take effect. A validator warns, without failing, for agent and for subagentStatusLine whatever their values (section 12.6 item 2).

agent.description: One of the plugin's own agents, run as the main thread (section 12.6 item 6). Deprecated: it still applies, with a warning at startup, in claude plugin list and from a validator.
